sloka: मित्रमौपयिकं कर्तुं रामः स्थानं परीप्सता ।वधं चानिच्छता घोरं त्वयासौ पुरुषर्षभः ।। ५.१९.१८।।।।
transliteration: mitramaupayikaṁ kartuṁ rāmaḥ sthānaṁ parīpsatā ।vadhaṁ cānicchatā ghoraṁ tvayāsau puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।। 5.19.18।।।।

translations.english: A delicate lady with beautiful limbs who deserved to be in a gemcrusted house was (now) like a lotus stem just plucked out and scorched by the Sun's heat.
